name: Encoder
description: Encodes a categorical column as dense integer labels or as one-hot 0/1 columns, one per configured category.

output.title: Output column
output.description: Label column name, or the prefix for one-hot columns (<output>_<category>).

method.title: Method
method.description: label assigns a dense rank per distinct value; onehot appends one 0/1 column per configured category.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Categories expanded into one-hot columns; required for the onehot method.

items.title: Category
items.description: Category value matching the input column type.
